name: S06_BACKTEST_AND_SCORECARD
description: Triggers strategy backtesting walk-forward jobs, retrieves scorecards, validates performance metrics (Win Rate, Profit Factor, Max Drawdown), and generates executive scorecard.

parameters.text: 📊 STRATEGY BACKTEST SCORECARD — {{2.data.symbol}} ({{2.data.timeframe}}) 🆔 Job ID: {{2.data.job_id}} 🔬 Strategy: {{2.data.strategy_version}} 📈 Win Rate: {{2.data.win_rate_percent}}% ({{2.data.winning_trades}}W / {{2.data.losing_trades}}L) 💵 Net Return: ${{2.data.net_profit}} ({{2.data.net_return_percent}}%) 🎯 Profit Factor: {{2.data.profit_factor}} 📉 Max Drawdown: {{2.data.max_drawdown_percent}}% (${{2.data.max_drawdown_usd}}) ⚖️ Average R-Multiple: {{2.data.average_r_multiple}}R 📦 Total Trades Evaluated: {{2.data.total_trades}} Walk-forward simulated without look-ahead bias and including spread/commissions.
